title: Grateful Dead Live at Recreation Hall, UC Davis on 1982-03-14
lineage: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi Dragon) > Pro Tools 12 > .wav 24/96 > Adobe Audition 2022 > TLH2496

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard transfer praised, though reviewers note unexpected minute‑long silences in Sugaree and Althea.
ai_review.review: The CM‑based transfer of this show receives high marks for its overall clarity and fidelity, with the reviewer calling it a “blessing” to the Dead archive. The only criticism is the addition of extended dead air during Sugaree and Althea, which the reviewer questions but does not detract from their overall enthusiasm.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed 5‑star review highlights excellent recording quality and only a minor issue (added silences), leading to a high rating despite limited information on the musical performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced transfer praised as a ‘blessing’, but includes an unexpected minute‑plus of dead air in Sugaree and Althea not present on other releases.
